title: Chapter 3 Quiz 17
description: A mix of everything in Chapter 3. Say how sure you are before you check each answer.
instructions: Take your time: read each question carefully, then check your answer.

questions.question: Which data type fits the value 'A', written between quotes?
questions.explanation: A single letter is a character. Watch out: a string is a set of characters, but one letter alone is a character.

questions.question: Which part of the program comes just before the main program?
questions.explanation: Order: types, constants, variables, functions and procedures, then the main program. Watch out: variables come earlier, not just before the main program.

questions.question: What is 29 MOD 6?
questions.explanation: 29 = 6 × 4 + 5, so the remainder is 5. Watch out: the quotient would be 4.

questions.question: What is 29 DIV 6?
questions.explanation: 6 × 4 = 24 and 29 - 24 = 5, so the integer quotient is 4. Watch out: the remainder would be 5.

questions.question: (x > 0) AND (x < 10) is True when x = 10.
questions.explanation: 10 < 10 is False, so the AND is False. Watch out: the bound 10 is excluded by the sign <.

questions.question: A program must run its body at least once before testing its condition. Which structure?
questions.explanation: Repeat...Until tests after the body. Watch out: While tests before, so it may never run.

questions.question: fact ← 1; For i From 1 To 4: fact ← fact * i. What is fact?
questions.explanation: 1 × 2 × 3 × 4 = 24. Watch out: the product starts at 1, not at 0.

questions.question: Trace: total ← 0; For i From 1 To 4: total ← total + i * 2.
questions.explanation: Add 2, 4, 6, 8 in turn: 2, 6, 12, 20. Watch out: i is multiplied by 2 before being added.

questions.question: What is the difference between a function and a procedure?
questions.explanation: Only functions provide a result. Watch out: both can have parameters, and a procedure is not recursive by nature.

questions.question: This should display the larger of a and b. Two lines are swapped by mistake.
questions.code:
Read(a, b)
If a > b Then
    Let max ← b
Else
    Let max ← a
EndIf
Display(max)
questions.explanation: When a > b the larger value is a, so the Then branch gives max ← a and the Else branch gives max ← b. Watch out: the test is right, but both assignments are crossed.

questions.question: This should calculate N!. One line is wrong. Find it and type the corrected line.
questions.code:
Read(n)
Let fact ← 0
For i From 1 To n Do
    fact ← fact * i
EndDo
Display(fact)
questions.explanation: A product must start at 1. Watch out: with fact ← 0 every product stays 0.

questions.question: The recursive factorial needs a base case because…
options: A loop must be added first
The result must be a real
questions.explanation: The base case stops the chain of calls. Watch out: without it, Fact(3) would call Fact(2), Fact(1), Fact(0), Fact(-1) and so on, for ever.

questions.question: What is F(6)? (Fibonacci: 0, 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8)
questions.explanation: F(6) = F(5) + F(4) = 5 + 3 = 8. Watch out: the sequence starts at F(0) = 0.
